name: Bidou
summary: A concealed three-dice poker-like bluffing game where players wager chips on hidden combinations, trying to lose all chips.
rules_text: Each player gets three dice, a cup, and chips - nine shared for two players, six each for more than two. Determine captain each round by highest single die roll. Captain rolls first. Each player rolls up to three times concealed under cup, announcing how many rolls used. 22 special combinations are ranked highest first: 2-1-1 (bidou), 1-1-1 beats bidou but otherwise low, 2-2-1 (bide), 4-2-1, triples 6-6-6 down to 2-2-2, pairs of 3 or 1 with kicker, and ladders/straights. Non-specials rank by dice values. Betting: fewest rolls bets first (captain if tied). In two players, bet 1, raise to 2, call or fold. If both pass, no chips move. If fold after betting, folder takes 1 penalty chip. If called, reveal - loser takes all chips bet. First to lose all chips loses. Three+ players similar with max bet 3, max raise 2. Montevideo variant reverses objective: winner takes pot.
rating_reason: Concealed dice, wagering pot, bluffing mechanics perfect for hidden_hands and bids
